Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

attempts.description: Attempts made so far. `1` on a failed job means the registry answered and refused; a value at the maintainer's retry ceiling means it never answered.

jobId.description: Identifier of the queued job. The handle `vtc/registry/sync-jobs/retry` and `.../discard` take.

lastError.description: The registry's last answer, verbatim. Diagnostic prose for an operator; a consumer MUST NOT parse it.

memberDid.description: The member whose registry record the job carries. In the clear, because an operator holding a hash cannot tell who stopped publishing.

nextAttemptAt.description: When it is next due. Null on a failed job: nothing is scheduled.

purgeDueAt.description: When the maintainer's retention sweep will delete this row. A deadline, not a fix — the member stays unpublished.

Kind.description: Which mutation the job carries to the registry.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.

Response.title: VTC Registry Sync Jobs List — response payload

State.description: `failed` is terminal: the reconciler has abandoned the job and will not retry it without an operator. `pending` and `inFlight` are moving on their own.

schema.description: Enumerate the community's trust-registry reconciliation queue. Each job is one pending or abandoned attempt to publish a membership change to the registry.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

state.description: Filter to jobs in this state. Omit for every state.
